name: TubeArchivistMetadata
description: TubeArchivistMetadata is a plugin that automatically manages metadata for videos downloaded with TubeArchivist from YouTube.
overview: Metadata for your TubeArchivist library on Jellyfin (playlist_sort fork)

versions.changelog:
Group seasons by TubeArchivist playlist instead of upload year
Add playlist index episode numbering scheme
Fix duplicated playlists caused by first-page pagination
Fix redirect handling while paging playlists
